title: My sidescroller with claude 7min gameplay
author: Comfortablebro
selftext:
All biomes work; few bugs exist. Game is postponed until claude decides to release a model that makes nice sounds, music.

**Gameplay:** lantern is important to keep dread at bay in certain biomes. Gaining powers and main campaign is not shown yet, the cutscene is skipped.

Would you play this game?

comments.author: onelittledragon
comments.body: Very nice. Do you have a link to the game?  I would to try it out.

replies.author: Comfortablebro
replies.body: Its just sitting on my pc.. i dont know how and where to "upload it". Its godot game so maybe it cannot be played online or on a browser.

comments.author: Pale_Proposal457
comments.body: Hate to tell you. But the name is gone 🫠

replies.author: Comfortablebro
replies.body: Oh you mean game exist with this name? hmm well i would rename it, i did not knew. I created the lore and then made the name.

replies.author: Pale_Proposal457
replies.body: Yea, name is in use. Quite recently a game was released named like yours.

comments.author: Suspicious_Bet3623
comments.body:
Honestly I never liked "retro" graphics, the only reason they came back is because small indie companies couldn't do better.  But now they can, and we are already absolutely flooded with low quality images.

And also honestly Prince of Persia is fun as a memory, nothing about the gameplay looks interesting today.
